description: Android activity class 'JobsActivityExtended' that loads and displays job details from JSON data, handles UI interactions, and navigates to a signature screen.

classes.name: JobsActivityExtended
classes.description: An Android activity class for displaying detailed job information and handling user interactions related to job status.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, retrieves intent data, and sets up button click listener.

methods.name: loadPageData
methods.description: Loads job data from JSON stored in SaveData, parses it, and populates UI elements with job, customer, pickup, and dropoff details.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes input strings by replacing null, empty, or 'null' strings with empty string.

methods.name: cleanAddress
methods.description: Sanitizes address strings and appends a comma if valid.
